text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The proposed routes.py is correct. best_route, sites_served, trips_needed, CAPACITY and DEFAULT_VEHICLE are preserved unchanged; the only additions are the can_pass import and the two new functions. passable_route filters routes exactly as routes_between does, marks a route usable if any of truck/van can pass every road via can_pass(road, vehicle, network) (signature matches logistics/access.py), picks min by (km, id) like best_route, returns (route, 'truck') only when a truck can use every road else (route, 'van'), and None when nothing is usable. rerouted_sites compares route ids (so a vehicle-only change does not count, e.g. SITE-NVL-B where passable and best are both RT-02, and SITE-HGL-B where both are RT-09) and returns names in order. Checked against data/network.json: SITE-CPL-B correctly reroutes from RT-05 (R-08 closed) to RT-06 (van via R-09 restricted), and SITE-HGL-A from RT-07 (R-12 closed) to RT-08 (truck)."}}
reasoning:
Check the proposed edit against the ticket.

passable_route: filters routes_between, checks any vehicle can pass all roads, picks min by (km, id), truck if truck can pass all roads else van, None if none. Matches ticket.

rerouted_sites: iterates warehouses and sites, compares passable route id vs best route id. Ticket: "the sites, in name order, for which passable_route finds a route that is different from the route best_route picks (the vehicle alone changing does not count)." Comparing route ids — correct. Sorted in name order — sorted(rerouted) at end, and sites_served returns sorted. Fine.

One subtlety: rerouted_sites iterates warehouses sorted, sites sorted, then sorted again — fine.

Edge: if passable is None but best exists — site not rerouted (no usable route). Ticket says "for which passable_route finds a route that is different" — if passable_route returns None, it doesn't find a route, so not included. Correct.

best_route unchanged — yes, identical to original.

sites_served and trips_needed preserved. CAPACITY, DEFAULT_VEHICLE preserved. Import adds can_pass — exists in access.py.

Check can_pass signature: can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) — proposed calls can_pass(road, vehicle, network) — fine.

Check behavior with data: e.g., SITE-NVL-B: RT-02 (R-01 A, R-03 R) — truck can't use R-03, van can: usable, van. RT-03 (R-04, R-05 both A): usable, truck. min by km: RT-02 (22) < RT-03 (31). So passable_route returns RT-02, van. best_route returns RT-02, truck. Route same, vehicle differs — rerouted_sites correctly excludes (compares ids). Good.

SITE-CPL-B: RT-05 has R-08 (X) — not usable. RT-06 (R-07 A, R-09 R) — van only, usable. passable = RT-06, van. best = RT-05. Rerouted. Good.

SITE-HGL-A: RT-07 has R-12 X — not usable. RT-08 (R-10, R-11 A) — truck. passable = RT-08. best = RT-07. Rerouted. Good.

SITE-HGL-B: RT-09 R-13 R — van only, usable. passable = RT-09, van. best = RT-09, truck. Same route — not rerouted. Good.

Everything checks out. Accept.
